v.why: With e0 removed node 1 is dead, so a conv on e4 has no input and the edit does almost nothing.
With e0 removed node 1 is dead, so e2 carries no signal and upgrading it cannot help.
A dead node 1 makes any op change on e4 irrelevant.
A dead node 1 makes any op change on e2 irrelevant.
Replacing none on e0 activates node 1 and its downstream edges, a big gain.
Replacing none on the direct edge adds a conv path straight to the output, a larger gain than swapping ops.
Replacing none adds a whole new path, a bigger gain than replacing an existing op.
Replacing none with a conv opens a new route into the output, a larger gain than modifying an existing op.
Replacing none on e2 adds a deeper 0->1->2->3 route, a larger gain than swapping ops.
Replacing none on e1 opens a new feature route into node 2, a larger gain than modifying an existing op.
